description: A source tells how an activity started: who or what brought a client, an appointment, a payment, an invoice, a document, a review or a cart. An activity references its source; one source can be referenced by more than one activity (for example a client and the appointment booked with it). A source is written once and does not change after it is created.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the source. Use it to reference the source and to look it up.

source_id.description: **Deprecated.** The legacy numeric identifier of the source. The legacy APIs still reference sources by it (for example the `source_id` of a client). Use `uid` for every new integration. It will be removed when no activity references sources by it.

name.description:
How the activity started, or null when it was not recorded. A free string: the platform writes the known values below, and apps and integrations write their own names.

**Started by the business:**
- **`initiated_by_staff`**: a staff member created the activity (for example a booking made by the business, or a manual invoice).
- **`staff_initiated`**: older spelling of `initiated_by_staff`.
- **`automation`**: an automation created it (for example a scheduled payment; then `campaign` is `scheduled_payments`).
- **`automatic_messages`**: an automatic message sent by the business led to it.
- **`added_internally`**: added inside the platform, for example by an import.

**Started by the client:**
- **`website`**, **`Website`**: the client used a widget, form or button on the business website. `Website` is written by the AI Receptionist.
- **`client_portal`**: the client used the client portal (booking, checkout, payment).
- **`campaign`**: the client answered a campaign; `campaign` holds the campaign uid.
- **`email_campaign`**, **`marketing`**, **`invitation`**, **`forward`**: the client came from an email campaign, a marketing channel, an invitation or a forwarded message.
- **`text_to_business_phone`**: the client sent a text message to the business phone.
- **`promotions_optin_by_keyword`**, **`promotions_opt-in_by_keyword`**, **`Promotions opt-in by Keyword`**: the client opted in to promotions with an SMS keyword (three spellings of one meaning).
- **`rwg_redirect`**: the client booked through Reserve with Google.
- **`Messenger`**, **`Instagram`**: the client wrote to the AI Receptionist on that channel.
- **`call`**: the client called the AI voice receptionist; `campaign` holds the business phone number.

**Unknown:**
- **`unknown`**: the platform did not record how the activity started.

**Apps and integrations** write their own names, for example `Square`, `Marketing Center`, `Thryv Leads` or `AI Receptionist`. The name is the app or the integration that created the activity.

channel.description: The channel inside the source, for example `client_portal_widget`, `scheduler_widget`, `contact_form`, `email`, `sms`, or `AI Receptionist`.

campaign.description: The campaign or the context of the source: a campaign uid (when `name` is `campaign`), a message key (when `name` is `automatic_messages`), the business phone number (when `name` is `call`), or `scheduled_payments`.

website_url.description: The page where the activity started, or the social page name. Values longer than 255 characters are cut.

utm_source.description: The `utm_source` of the ad click or link. Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature.

utm_medium.description: The `utm_medium` of the ad click or link. Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature.

utm_campaign.description: The `utm_campaign` of the ad click or link. Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature.

utm_term.description: The `utm_term` of the ad click or link. Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature.

utm_content.description: The `utm_content` of the ad click or link. Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature.

gclid.description: The Google Ads click identifier. Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature.

created_at.description: When the source was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

updated_at.description: When the source was last updated (ISO 8601, UTC).
